predictions.notes: Base rate: 2026 U-6 SA is range-bound 7.9-8.2 (mean 8.03, sd of monthly change 0.18), June at 7.9. Disconfirming: two straight declines could mark a real downshift below the range, and July SA is noisy (auto retooling, teen employment). Verified against BLS LNS13327709 live.
